answer: Copying the same citations across 188 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 188 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the canyon check immediately, the mesa audit keeps the resolved set and the delta replay publishes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
